content: रुष् I. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (रुष्यति; rarely रुष्यते; रुषित, रुष्ट) To be angry, to be vexed or annoyed, be offended; ततोऽरुष्यदनर्दच्च <ls>Bk. 17. 40</ls>; मा मुहो मा रुषोऽधुना <ls n="Bk.">15. 16</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">9. 20</ls>. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (रोषति) .²1 To hurt, injure, kill. .²2 To vex, annoy. .²3 <ab>Ved.</ab> To be offended. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To provoke, engage, exasperate.
रुष्, रुषा {%f.%} Anger, wrath, rage; निर्बन्धसंजातरुषा <ls>R. 5. 21</ls>; प्रह्वेष्वनिर्बन्धरुषो हि सन्तः <ls n="R.">16. 80</ls>, <ls n="R.">19. 20</ls>.
